title: Previews go stale after a file changes, and loads for items already passed are never cancelled
problem: `ensure_preview` caches by path only: `if self.previews.contains_key(&path) || self.preview_tasks.contains_key(&path) { return; }` (src/finder/preview.rs:311). When a file is edited and the folder is reread, the listing gets fresh entries (src/finder/mod.rs:1069-1103) but `previews` is untouched, so the preview pane, column card, gallery and Quick Look keep the old text beside the new size and date. Only Refresh (mod.rs:1200), an appearance change, a rename, or passing 256 entries (preview.rs:314-316) clears it. Thumbnails (src/thumbnails.rs:21-23), PDFs (src/finder/pdf.rs:273-276) and fonts (preview.rs:120) are already keyed by modification time; text, code, table, archive and folder-count previews are not. Explore mode has the same path-only check (src/finder/explore.rs:481). Separately, every selection step calls `ensure_preview` (mod.rs:1720-1731, reached from `move_selection`), and each load is stored in `preview_tasks` and removed only when it finishes (preview.rs:320-349). Holding an arrow key in the gallery, columns, or with the preview pane or Quick Look open therefore queues one full `load_preview` per item passed, including a `nu` process per .nu, SQLite or spreadsheet file with a 10 s timeout (src/nushell.rs:380-401), and the item the cursor stops on waits behind them. PDF pages and explore mode already cancel by dropping their tasks (pdf.rs:124-126, explore.rs:398-402).
proposal: preview.rs / mod.rs: (1) Store a stamp with each cached preview: `previews: HashMap<PathBuf, (Option<SystemTime>, Option<u64>, Preview)>` holding `entry.modified` and `entry.size`. `ensure_preview` treats a stamp mismatch as missing and reloads, while `preview_of` keeps returning the old preview until the new one arrives so there is no spinner flash. (2) Replace `preview_tasks: HashMap` with a single `preview_task: Option<(PathBuf, Task<()>)>`; starting a load for another path drops the previous task (all surfaces show `primary_entry()`, so one is enough). Put a 30 ms `cx.background_executor().timer` before the `background_spawn`, as the search debounce does (mod.rs:1391-1395), so key-repeat never starts work for items passed. (3) Call `selection_changed(cx)` at the end of `rebuild_rows` when a preview is wanted, so a reread listing re-validates the shown item. (4) For in-place edits that do not move the folder's change time: in `check_for_changes` (mod.rs:1114-1142) add the previewed file's path to the existing background pass, stat it there, and if its mtime or length differs from the stamp, replace the entry via `FileEntry::from_path` and call `ensure_preview`. (5) explore.rs:481: compare `modified` as well as the path.
original_test_plan: Headless UI tests in tests/basics.rs with a new `#[doc(hidden)] preview_text_for_test(&Path) -> Option<String>`. Stale: preview pane on, select notes.txt, assert the text is 'plain notes' plus a newline; rewrite the file with other content and a later mtime (`File::set_modified`), `ui.deactivate(); ui.activate();` (runs `check_for_changes`), settle, and assert the new text. Add a variant that changes the file through a temp file and rename. Cancel: in the gallery, `ui.click_without_settling(item_id("strip", &a))` then `ui.click(item_id("strip", &b))`; assert `has_preview_for_test(&b)` and `!has_preview_for_test(&a)`.
original_risks: Dropping a task only stops work that has not started; a `nu` child already running finishes and its result is discarded (killing it would need a handle from nushell.rs). The 30 ms delay is added to every first preview; UI tests are unaffected because `settle()` advances the clock 600 ms (tests/common/mod.rs:246-253). `has_preview_for_test` (mod.rs:706) and the two `previews.remove` callers (dialogs.rs:846, batch_rename.rs:227) need the new map shape. The marquee test tests/basics.rs:87-107 must keep passing.

verifier.claim_check:
Both described behaviours are real; several details of the proposal are wrong. I read the code only (no cargo run).

**Stale previews: confirmed.**
- `ensure_preview` returns early on a path-only check (src/finder/preview.rs:311) and `preview_of` reads by path (preview.rs:352-357).
- A quiet reread (`check_for_changes` -> `reload_changed` -> `load_listing(Vec::new(), true)`, src/finder/mod.rs:1114-1183) replaces `listing` and calls `rebuild_rows`, but calls `selection_changed` only when `select` paths were found (mod.rs:1091-1102). `previews` is never touched.
- The preview card draws the fresh `entry.size` and `entry.modified` (preview.rs:815-832, 854-859) beside the old text. It stays that way across re-selection and navigation.
- Nothing else invalidates: `previews` is cleared only at mod.rs:519, 1200, 2276, 2288, 2339, removed per path at dialogs.rs:846 and batch_rename.rs:227, and dropped past 256 entries (preview.rs:314). There is no watcher hook.
- PDFs (pdf.rs:273-276), thumbnails (thumbnails.rs:23) and `LoadedFonts` (preview.rs:120) are keyed by mtime; explore mode is path-only (explore.rs:481).
- Not already handled, and not intentional. docs/manual.md:130 documents only that an in-place content change keeps its old size and date until the folder changes or you refresh. manual.md:503 says Refresh reloads previews.

**A second bug the candidate missed.** After `previews.clear()` nothing asks for the shown item again outside the gallery. Only `render_gallery` re-ensures per frame (views.rs:1228); `render_preview_pane` takes `&self`. So after Refresh or an appearance change, the preview pane, the column card and Quick Look appear to spin until the selection changes.

**No cancellation: confirmed, but overstated.**
- `preview_tasks` entries are removed only on completion (preview.rs:342, 349), and every step calls `ensure_preview` (mod.rs:1822 -> 1720-1725; 2914; preview.rs:564).
- Loads run on a thread pool with one thread per core (gpui-pre-linux dispatcher.rs:33-36), so the item the cursor stops on waits only once more loads are in flight than there are cores. That needs many slow previews: `nu`, big tar.gz, fonts.
- Finished loads for passed items are cached today, so they are not pure waste.

**Errors in the proposal.**
- A 30 ms timer is at or below ordinary key-repeat intervals (about 30-90 ms), so it would not stop work starting for passed items, and it delays every preview.
- A single task slot throws away results that are cached today.
- dialogs.rs:846 and batch_rename.rs:227 call `HashMap::remove`, and `has_preview_for_test` (mod.rs:706) calls `contains_key`. None depends on the value type, so those two files need no edit.
- Step 3 misses column panes after the first: `load_column` (mod.rs:2922-2951) never calls `rebuild_rows`.
- Step 4 compares a fresh stat with entry values. Search hits carry whole-second mtimes from the index (crates/fffinder-core/src/engine.rs:1381-1390), so that never matches and would reload every 2 s. `decorate` also rewrites folder sizes (src/finder/list.rs:133-137).
- `check_for_changes` returns early when no folder is on screen (mod.rs:1126-1129), so step 4 would not run in Recents, Trash or Results.
- The test plan's in-place `std::fs::write` does not move the folder's mtime, so `deactivate`/`activate` would not reread the listing.
verifier.implementation_notes:
Do the staleness fix. Split cancellation and in-place detection into follow-ups.

**A. Stamp the cache (mod.rs:327-328, preview.rs:309-357)**
- `type PreviewStamp = (Option<SystemTime>, Option<u64>)`, built only from the entry passed in: `(entry.modified, if entry.is_dir { None } else { entry.size })`.
- Leave folder size out: `decorate` (list.rs:133-137) rewrites a folder row's size once folder stats land.
- Never compare against a fresh stat: search hits have whole-second mtimes (engine.rs:1381-1390), and the gallery calls `ensure_preview` every frame (views.rs:1228), so an unstable stamp would loop load -> notify -> render.
- `previews: HashMap<PathBuf, (PreviewStamp, Preview)>` and `preview_tasks: HashMap<PathBuf, (PreviewStamp, Task<()>)>`.
- `ensure_preview` returns only when the cached or in-flight stamp equals the entry's. Otherwise it inserts a new task; replacing the map entry drops the superseded task.
- Keep the old cached value until the new one lands, so `preview_of` never flashes a spinner. Change the 256 cap to `retain(|p, _| *p == path)`.
- `has_preview_for_test`, dialogs.rs:846 and batch_rename.rs:227 compile unchanged.

**B. Re-validate after every reread, at the load completions (not in `rebuild_rows`)**
- `rebuild_rows` runs on every filter keystroke and before `load_listing` applies `select`, which would start a wasted load for the old selection.
- mod.rs:1095-1102: call `this.selection_changed(cx)` unconditionally after the select handling.
- list.rs:195-199 (`load_children`): call it after `rebuild_rows`.
- mod.rs:2939-2947 (`load_column`): call it after the entries are replaced. The proposal misses this one.
- `selection_changed` (mod.rs:1720-1732) already gates on `wants_preview`.

**C. Fix the stuck spinner**
- Add `fn forget_previews(&mut self, cx)` that clears and then calls `selection_changed(cx)`.
- Use it at mod.rs:519, 2276, 2288 and 2339. Refresh (mod.rs:1200) is covered by B once the listing lands; keep its clear.

**D. Explore mode**
- Add `modified: Option<SystemTime>` to `Explore` (explore.rs:391-396), set it at explore.rs:515, and compare it at explore.rs:481.
- Leave the path-only filters at explore.rs:502 and 530.

**E. Test hook and changelog**
- Add `#[doc(hidden)] pub fn preview_text_for_test(&self, path: &Path) -> Option<String>` next to mod.rs:706, returning the text of `Text`, `Code` and `Markdown`.
- Add a Fixed entry under `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md. manual.md:130 stays true.

**Follow-up 1: cancellation (optional)**
- Do not use the 30 ms timer or the single slot.
- Keep the map and add a `latest: Arc<AtomicU64>` bumped in `ensure_preview`. The background closure returns `None` without loading when its generation is no longer the latest, and the completion removes the task without inserting.
- This skips only loads that had not started, which is the saturated case, keeps caching for loads that ran, and adds no latency.
- A running `nu` still cannot be killed without a handle from nushell.rs.

**Follow-up 2: in-place edits (proposal step 4)**
- Store a second stamp read by the loader's own `fs::metadata`, and compare disk to disk in the background pass.
- Restructure the early returns at mod.rs:1123-1129 so the pass runs with no folder on screen.
- If entries are patched, patch only `size` and `modified` in `listing`, `results`, `children` and `columns`, and reword manual.md:130.
verifier.test_plan:
Headless UI tests in tests/basics.rs, in the preview pane section (after line 919), using `Fixture`, `Ui::open`, `ui.select`, `ui.update`, `ui.press`, `cmd` and `item_id` from tests/common/mod.rs, plus the new `preview_text_for_test`.

1. **Stale text in the pane.**
   - `ui.click("view-list")`, `ui.press(&cmd("shift-p"))`, `ui.select("notes.txt")`; assert the text is "plain notes\n".
   - `std::fs::write` the file with longer text, so the size differs whatever the mtime granularity.
   - `ui.update(|f, _, cx| f.reload_quietly(cx))`, the same idiom as basics.rs:1002-1003; assert the new text. This fails today.
   - Do not use `deactivate`/`activate` here: an in-place write does not move the folder's mtime.
2. **Columns after the first.**
   - `ui.click("view-columns")`, then click `item_id("crow", ..)` for Projects, Projects/atlas and "Project Atlas.txt"; assert "atlas".
   - Rewrite the file, `reload_quietly`, assert the new text. This covers the `load_column` hook.
3. **Refresh.**
   - With the pane on and notes.txt selected, `ui.press(&cmd("r"))`; assert `has_preview_for_test(&fx.path("notes.txt"))`.
   - By my reading this is false today.
4. **Explore mode**, only where `fffinder::nushell::find_nu(None)` finds `nu`, beside tests/finder.rs:395: rewrite a JSON file, `reload_quietly`, check the explore summary changes.
5. **Must stay green.**
   - basics.rs:87-107 (the marquee loads nothing for crossed items) and basics.rs:922-949.
   - controls.rs:520-579, 1083-1132 and 1243-1300.
   - `previews_by_kind` in src/finder/preview.rs.
6. **If the cancellation follow-up is done.**
   - `ui.click("view-gallery")`, which selects Budget.csv.
   - `ui.click_without_settling(item_id("strip", &notes))` (precedent at controls.rs:671), then `ui.click(item_id("strip", &roadmap))`.
   - Assert `has_preview_for_test(&roadmap)` and `!has_preview_for_test(&notes)`. This is deterministic because the generation is bumped synchronously.
verifier.risks:
- **Reload loop.** The gallery calls `ensure_preview` every frame, so a stamp that differs between sources of the same path, or one compared against a fresh stat, loops load -> notify -> render. The stamp must come only from the passed entry and leave out folder sizes.
- **Extra reloads between search and folder.** Search hits carry whole-second mtimes, so the same file reloads once when switching between search results and its folder. It is harmless because the old preview stays up meanwhile.
- **Explore position.** Explore mode loses its drill-down position when the file's mtime changes.
- **More work per reread.** `selection_changed` now runs on every quiet reread and, with Quick Look open, also runs `ensure_pdf` and `ensure_explore`. Both do nothing when unchanged.
- **Index-based column selection.** `pane.selected` is an index, so after a column reread it can point at a different file. That is an existing problem, and the new hook would then preview that file.
- **In-place saves stay stale.** Saves that do not move the folder's mtime, such as plain overwrites, still show the old preview, size and date until Refresh, as manual.md:130 documents. The changelog entry should not claim more.
- **Unverified reading.** The stuck spinner after Refresh comes from reading the code, not from running it. Test 3 will show whether it is real.
